subject: Lost Tomb of Khaem
fact: The Lost Tomb of Khaem contains a stone diorama depicting Netherese noble Brysis of Khaem surrounded by her retinue, a sprawling mural of floating cities, a Netherese Calendar Stone, a shrine littered with dusty tapestries, four stone sarcophagi marked with robed human figures in repose, a hidden passage revealed by rolling the northeast sarcophagus, a chamber with a gilded sarcophagus, and an invisible stone chest near its foot.
source_quote: A stone diorama stands to the right, depicting a Netherese noble, Brysis of Khaem, surrounded by her retinue, flaunting wealth and power. To the left, a sprawling mural covers the wall, illustrating fantastic floating cities. ... On one landing, I note a Netherese Calendar Stone... The stairs finally give way to a shrine, its floor littered with shreds of dusty tapestries. ... Four stone sarcophagi. Markings of robed human figures in repose adorn their lids. ... The northeast sarcophagus rests on hidden stone rollers. ... A gilded sarcophagus gleams against one wall, clearly the focal point, and I notice the subtle shimmer of an invisible stone chest near its foot.

subject: Brysis of Khaem
fact: Brysis of Khaem was a Netherese noble sorceress whose tomb contains her diorama, murals of floating cities, and is guarded by undead retainers bound to her will, including Spectres and a Wraith who declares, 'Your deaths will free me from this prison, and how my victims will serve me even in death!'
source_quote: A stone diorama stands to the right, depicting a Netherese noble, Brysis of Khaem... ... a Wraith. Its voice, resonant with ancient menace, fills our minds... 'Your deaths will free me from this prison, and how my victims will serve me even in death!'

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth has been hiding the group's tracks for two days in the Faerzress crystal cave, and is reasonably convinced they have thrown the Drow off their trail, though she worries every time they alter the environment.
source_quote: For two days, Eldeth has been hiding our tracks for two days... Eldeth is worried; she’s reasonably convinced we have thrown the Drow off our tracks, but every time we mess with the environment, we make it easier for them.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith insisted he knew where the group was going, and later confirms the direction of the trapped voice leads exactly to the Lost Tomb of Khaem, nodding yes when asked if it’s the way they intended to go.
source_quote: Sarith insisted he knew where we were going... Sarith nods yes, this is the way. Of course, it does.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir, a dragonborn monk, speaks only when there is truly something to say, invokes a sphere of magical darkness to conceal the sarcophagus, and punches and pummels Spectres to death, declaring, 'I will punch the ghost!'
source_quote: My vow of silence, of speaking only when there's truly something to say... I call forth the shadows, plunging the area around the sarcophagus into a sphere of magical darkness... Zalthir, ever the whirlwind, moves his sphere of darkness, then his fists become blurs in the gloom, punching and pummeling... 'I will punch the ghost!' he declares.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a Drow of Menzoberranzan who casts Magic Missile to destroy Spectres, suffers necrotic damage from their touch, and muses on the likelihood of returning undead if they take a long rest, noting, 'I'm gonna need a long rest here pretty soon.'
source_quote: I am a Drow of Menzoberranzan... With a familiar incantation, I conjure the shimmering darts of pure force. Magic Missile... One Spectre lunges at me... twice as much necrotic damage, and my strength wanes further... 'I'm gonna need a long rest here pretty soon,' I mutter... If we rest, we will find them here when we come back.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum, with keen perception, takes the lead in the tomb, notices recent damage but no tracks in the dust, recalls tales of floating undead, observes the invisible stone chest, and is overcome by the chilling presence of a Wraith that declares, 'Your deaths will free me from this prison, and how my victims will serve me even in death!'
source_quote: Grygum, with his keen perception, takes the lead... He notes recent damage but no tracks in the thick layer of dust... He then recalls old tales of 'floating undead creatures that typically rest in tombs'... I notice the subtle shimmer of an invisible stone chest near its foot... A Wraith. Its voice, resonant with ancient menace... 'Your deaths will free me from this prison, and how my victims will serve me even in death!'

subject: Fuurm Coppernose
fact: Fuurm Coppernose, or Copper, is a starving human escapee from the Drow who was once a farmer and lost his sister in the Underdark while searching for her, and now carries a crystal as a weapon.
source_quote: The male, dressed in rags and starving, explains that his name is Fuurm Coppernose, or Copper to his friends, who had lost his sister and went looking for her in the Underdark... He holds a crystal as a weapon.

subject: Baedora
fact: Baedora is a starving woman dressed in rags who escaped the Drow after demons attacked, and explains that fleeing Drow and Demons was their best chance at survival.
source_quote: Baedora, the woman who is dressed in rags as well, and is equally starving, explains, 'That it was demons that attacked. The Drow fought back. We ran. Figured we were more likely to stay alive away from Drow and Demons.'

subject: Faerzress crystal cave
fact: The Faerzress crystal cave contains fist-sized quartz crystals erupting from the walls, emitting a dim ten-foot radiance, and is where Eldeth hid the group's tracks for two days before they smashed the cavern to disguise their escape.
source_quote: Ahead, there was no longer the rough-hewn stone, but an area suffused with the arcane glowing magic of the Faerzress. Fist-sized chunks of quartz crystals erupted from the wall, shedding a dim ten-foot radiance... To hide our tracks, we smash the cavern and the crystals, as if some monster had attacked, not escaped slaves who took crystals that shone in the darkness.

subject: Fungal forest chamber
fact: The fungal forest chamber contains towering stalks and caps of fungi, some glowing faintly with bioluminescent light, others earthy brown, and is where the group encountered Shriekers whose noise did not react to thrown crystals.
source_quote: There were the towering stalks and caps of fungi, a veritable forest of the subterranean. Mushrooms of all kinds and of all types, stretching up into the unseen ceiling, some glowing faintly with a soft, bioluminescent light, others a muted, earthy brown... The crystal sailed through the air... and the shrieking... didn't change.

subject: Faerzress crystals
fact: Faerzress crystals are fist-sized quartz chunks that emit a dim ten-foot radiance, are collected by the group, and later smashed to disguise their escape from the cave.
source_quote: Fist-sized chunks of quartz crystals erupted from the wall, shedding a dim ten-foot radiance... We have collected so many strays that one more won’t harm us... To hide our tracks, we smash the cavern and the crystals...

subject: Netherese treasure
fact: Netherese treasure consists of mummified remains, tattered burial garments, and valuable artifacts found inside the sarcophagi of the Lost Tomb of Khaem, worth great amounts of gold and more to collectors.
source_quote: Each sarcophagus contains mummified remains, the tattered remnants of ancient burial garments, and treasure of Netherese origin. They are worth a great deal as gold, and perhaps even more to the right collector.

subject: Spectres
fact: Spectres are incorporeal undead that hover in the tomb, attack with chilling touch causing necrotic damage, are vulnerable to Magic Missile, and are destroyed by Zalthir's punches and Daz's spells.
source_quote: Four Spectres now hover, incorporeal and menacing... One Spectre lunges at me... necrotic damage... Magic Missile... Zalthir... kills one, then another.

subject: Wraith
fact: A Wraith rises from the gilded sarcophagus in the inner chamber, declares, 'Your deaths will free me from this prison, and how my victims will serve me even in death!', and has the power to turn its victims into Spectres.
source_quote: A Wraith. Its voice, resonant with ancient menace, fills our minds... 'Your deaths will free me from this prison, and how my victims will serve me even in death!'... I remember that a wraith, when it kills, turns its victims into specters...

subject: Shriekers
fact: Shriekers are creatures whose piercing, multi-layered shrieks vibrate through rock and trigger survival instincts, but do not react to thrown crystals or environmental changes.
source_quote: A sudden, piercing shriek that ripped through the heavy air... Not one, but many. Shriekers... The crystal sailed through the air... and the shrieking... didn't change.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin, strong as an ox, leverages Zalthir's darkness to push aside the northeast sarcophagus, revealing a hidden passage, and leads the descent into the inner chamber.
source_quote: Thorin, strong as an ox, leverages the darkness, pushing the heavy sarcophagus aside... Thorin taking the lead, his broad shoulders easily pushing through the confined space.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar starts a new round of bets, including one with Grygum on whether the Faerzress crystals will be useful, and is confused when others initiate wagers.
source_quote: Jimjar shouts, 'Want to make a bet?'... 'Wanna bet that these crystals will be useful?'... He looks at me, confused. He’s not used to other people making the bet.

subject: Stool
fact: Stool is a myconid who curls up contentedly against Thorin's back, having ridden the dwarf, and is described as reliving his 'good idea' to ride on the dwarf.
source_quote: Stool, my new myconid friend, was curled up contentedly against Thorin's back, probably still reliving his 'good idea' to ride on the dwarf.

subject: Discovery of the hidden passage
fact: The hidden passage is revealed when Thorin pushes the northeast sarcophagus on hidden rollers, while Zalthir envelops the area in magical darkness, allowing the group to access the true tomb.
source_quote: The northeast sarcophagus rests on hidden stone rollers... I call forth the shadows, plunging the area around the sarcophagus into a sphere of magical darkness... Thorin... pushes the heavy sarcophagus aside. The stone grinds, revealing... a hole. The true tomb, perhaps.

subject: Defeat of the four Spectres
fact: The four Spectres are defeated through combined efforts: Daz's Magic Missile strikes two, Zalthir punches and kills two, Grygum's turning attempt fails, and the group survives the necrotic drain from the undead touch.
source_quote: Magic Missile... two bolts... striking a second Spectre... Zalthir... kills one, then another... Grygum... tries to turn them, but the Spectres resist... One Spectre lunges at me... twice as much necrotic damage...

subject: Rise of the Wraith
fact: A Wraith rises from the gilded sarcophagus after the group opens the hidden passage, declares its intent to free itself through their deaths, and threatens to turn them into Spectres.
source_quote: From the sarcophagus, a figure rises, ethereal and malicious. A Wraith. Its voice... 'Your deaths will free me from this prison, and how my victims will serve me even in death!'

subject: Collection of Netherese treasure
fact: The group opens the sarcophagi and collects mummified remains, tattered burial garments, and Netherese artifacts worth great sums of gold and collector value, before proceeding deeper into the tomb.
source_quote: We open the sarcophagi. Each sarcophagus contains mummified remains, the tattered remnants of ancient burial garments, and treasure of Netherese origin. They are worth a great deal as gold, and perhaps even more to the right collector.

subject: Netherese shrine
fact: The Netherese shrine contains dusty tapestries, a Netherese Calendar Stone, and leads to a staircase descending to the tomb’s inner chambers, where the sarcophagi and Wraith are found.
source_quote: The stairs finally give way to a shrine, its floor littered with shreds of dusty tapestries. ... On one landing, I note a Netherese Calendar Stone...

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is resistant to fire.
source_quote: Daz contemplates a Fireball, but then remembers that they are resistant to fire.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin's armor and the grace of Bahamut protect him.
source_quote: But the dwarf's armor and the grace of Bahamut protect him.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir casts his magical darkness, spreading it to cover the entire room.
source_quote: Zalthir moves. Ever the tactician, he casts his magical darkness, spreading it to cover the entire room.

subject: sarcophagus
fact: The sarcophagus contains a soft, feminine voice from earlier, the one that first called to us.
source_quote: Just as the lid creaks aside, the soft, feminine voice from earlier, the one that first called to us, speaks again, "In the sarcophagus! I can help you!"

subject: the trapped entity
fact: The trapped entity is the true owner of the voice.
source_quote: So, the trapped entity, the true owner of the voice, is inside this sarcophagus.

subject: tomb
fact: The tomb plunges into an even deeper, magical gloom.
source_quote: The already dim tomb plunges into an even deeper, magical gloom.

subject: the Wraith
fact: The Wraith glides forward, a silent, menacing presence, and attacks Thorin.
source_quote: The wraith glides forward, a silent, menacing presence, and attacks Thorin.

subject: sarcophagus
fact: The Wraith hovers back into its sarcophagus.
source_quote: Then, in a move I find utterly infuriating, the Wraith hovers back into its sarcophagus.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir looks in.
source_quote: Zalthir looks in.
